title: 第一章 摸尸跑路
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
城外西山破庙旁，猴子正蹲在两具尚有余温的尸体旁。

    一具黑袍，一具白袍。

    猴子指尖扒拉着两人的衣袍，嘴里碎碎念：“前些天还隔着半条街冻得人骨头缝发寒的江湖高手呢，还不是栽在这里，吃了大瘪。不过也真厉害，庙墙都塌了半边。”

    手没停，里里外外摸了个遍。

    黑袍身上只摸出一个软布袋，空溜溜的，连个铜板都没有。

    又翻去摸白袍的尸体，妈的，也只摸出个一模一样的布袋。

    指尖蹭过袋口，好像摸到一层滑溜溜的薄皮，再仔细捏，又没了踪影，只当是自己摸错了。

    这时，猴子突然瞥见白袍胸口的伤口旁，别着一口三寸长的小剑。

    他赶紧一把薅下来，指尖刚碰到，就传来一丝钻骨头的凉意。

    明明不是金不是银，入手却温润压手，刃口亮得吓人，轻轻一碰就划破了指尖的薄皮。他随手往旁边的碎石上一划，拇指粗的石头直接断成两截，切口比菜刀削的还齐整。猴子愣了一下，只当是这玩意儿钢口好，随手又揣回了怀里。

    实在没别的东西了，猴子对着尸体念叨了句：

    “小石头，给你报了仇。你可得保佑我发点小财呀。”

    随手打开布袋往地上一倒，空空如也，连个碎银子渣都没掉出来。

    “不是吧？连王爷都点头哈腰的贵客，别说碎银子，连几个铜板都没？老子混岳州城那些年，摸了那么多尸体，就没见过这么寒酸的！”

    猴子掂了掂手里的布袋，眉头皱得死紧。

    邪门了，捏起来软乎乎的，里里外外连个夹层都没有，可掂在手里却坠得慌，沉甸甸的压手，没道理是空的。

    不过现在不是琢磨这个的时候。

    王爷的两个贵客死在破庙，一旦被发现，铁定要抓个替罪羊顶罪。

    得赶紧溜！

    把布袋和小剑重新塞回怀里，猴子猫着腰冲出破庙。

    背后的破庙在月色里越缩越小，彻底隐进了黑暗里。

    猴子却不知道他摸的尸体原来是仙师。

    破庙旁突然亮起了大片火把光芒，狗吠人声交织在一起。

    猴子回头一望，心里一紧，这下可不能回城了。再往西去就是人人谈起色变的十万大山，传说中各种妖魔鬼怪都有，猴子想没办法了，只能往那里躲了，别太深入应该没事才对。

    猴子往西一头扎进老林子，专挑野径走，越走越深。

    身后那座城早被层层山影吞了，耳边除了鸟叫就是溪水声。此时天已亮了。

    他在一处溪沟边停下来，蹲下去捧水洗脸，冷水激得他一哆嗦。
content_en:
Next to the ruined temple on the west mountain outside the city, the monkey was squatting next to two corpses that were still warm.

    One is in black robe and the other is in white robe.

    The monkey's fingertips tugged at the robes of the two of them, and muttered: "A few days ago, the master of martial arts who was half a street away from me was so cold that his bones were freezing. He fell here and suffered a big blow. But it was really powerful. Half of the temple wall collapsed."

    His hands didn't stop, touching everything inside and out.

    Only a soft cloth bag was found on the black robe. It was empty, not even a copper coin.

    He turned around and touched Baipao's body again. Damn it, he only found an identical cloth bag.

    When I rubbed my fingertips across the mouth of the bag, I felt like I felt a thin layer of slippery skin. I pinched it carefully and there was no trace of it again. I just thought I had touched it by mistake.

    At this time, the monkey suddenly caught a glimpse of a three-inch long sword stuck next to the wound on Baipao's chest.

    He quickly pulled it down, and as soon as his fingertips touched it, he felt a bone-chilling chill.

    It was obviously neither gold nor silver, but it felt warm and gentle to the hand. The blade was so bright that it cut the thin skin of the fingertips with just a light touch. He casually scratched the gravel next to him, and the stone as thick as his thumb was broken into two pieces. The cut was neater than a kitchen knife. The monkey was stunned for a moment, thinking that this thing had a steel mouth, and put it back into his arms.

    There was really nothing else, so the monkey muttered to the corpse:

    "Little Shitou, I've avenged you. You have to help me make a little fortune."

    He casually opened the bag and poured it on the ground. It was empty, not even a scrap of silver fell out.

    "Isn't it? Even the prince nodded and bowed as a distinguished guest, not to mention broken silver, not even a few copper coins? I have touched so many corpses in the years I lived in Yuezhou City, but I have never seen such a shabby one!"

    The monkey weighed the bag in his hand and frowned.

    It's weird, it's soft when you hold it, and there's not even a layer between the inside and the outside. But when you hold it in your hand, it falls heavily. It's so heavy that it's empty for no reason.

    But now is not the time to ponder this.

    The prince's two distinguished guests died in the ruined temple. Once they are discovered, a scapegoat will be found to take the blame.

    Gotta run away quickly!

    Putting the cloth bag and the small sword back into his arms, the monkey rushed out of the ruined temple with his waist down.

    The ruined temple behind shrank smaller and smaller in the moonlight, completely disappearing into the darkness.

    The monkey didn't know that the corpse he touched turned out to be an immortal master.

    A large torch light suddenly lit up next to the ruined temple, and the sounds of dogs barking and people mingled together.

    The monkey looked back and felt nervous. He couldn't go back to the city now. Further west is the Shiwanda Mountain that everyone talks about. It is said that there are all kinds of monsters and monsters. The monkey has no choice but to hide there. Don't go too deep and it should be fine.

    The monkey plunged into the old forest to the west, walking on wild paths, going deeper and deeper.

    The city behind him has long been swallowed up by the shadows of mountains, and the only sounds in his ears are the chirping of birds and the sound of streams. It was daybreak by now.

    He stopped by a creek and squatted down to wash his face with water. The cold water made him shiver.
title_en: Chapter 1: Run away with a dead body
